key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:558C
name: close_opened_libraries
description: Closes the two library bases through the library close routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:55A8
name: format_decimal_number_string
description: Writes a number as decimal digits into the buffer, recursing on the higher part and appending each lowest digit, and returns the pointer past the last digit; zero gives a single zero character.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:55BC
name: append_decimal_number_field
description: Writes the argument as decimal digits at the buffer position held in a field, advances that position and returns it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:55F6
name: index_occupied_squares
description: Walks the 64 squares and, for each occupied one, records its square index in the lookup tables and calls a routine with the matching entry, building the list of occupied squares.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:569A
name: interpolate_line_coordinate
description: Computes an interpolated position between two endpoints by dividing the difference by a step count with rounding, storing the horizontal coordinate and then doing the same for the vertical.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:5726
name: compute_step_position_pair
description: Computes the next horizontal and vertical positions from the current position and a step size with rounding, storing both results in the working fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:577A
name: compute_vertical_step_position
description: Computes the vertical position for a step as the base row plus a scaled step with rounding toward zero, storing it in the working vertical field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:57A8
name: record_square_event_in_ring
description: Records a board event: for one message type it stores the source square's piece bits in the selection field, for other types it marks the square's table entry, then appends an entry to a 32-slot ring of square events.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:57DE
name: append_square_event_entry
description: Stores the piece bits for the chosen square, advances a 32-slot ring index and links a new entry into the list of events for that square.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:57F4
name: link_square_entry_into_list
description: Marks the square's slot in the occupancy table when its piece kind is not the empty code, advances the ring index and links the new entry into the square's list.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:5856
name: update_square_link_entries
description: Walks the chain of entries for a square, stamping each with the new ring index and filling its colour, kind and state bytes, and adjusts a counter when a special piece kind is involved.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:5872
name: stamp_square_entry_fields
description: Stamps a single square entry with the new ring index, colour, kind and state bytes and clears its link fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:58DC
name: call_routine_then_return
description: Calls a routine with no arguments and returns to the caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:58F2
name: record_new_square_entry
description: Advances the ring index and writes a new entry with the two square coordinates and piece bytes, marks both slot flags, stores the index as the latest entry and records the selection state for a special piece kind.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:596A
name: read_last_entry_index
description: Stores the piece bits of the given square into the current selection and returns the index of the most recent entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:5980
name: mark_square_slot_used
description: When the kind code is not the sentinel value, sets the square's occupancy slot to one and returns the index of the latest entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:59B6
name: allocate_square_event_record
description: Takes a free record from the allocator, copies the square's colour, kind and position fields into it, computes its board pointer from the square's byte and returns the record.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:611A
name: append_to_linked_list
description: Walks to the tail of the singly linked list headed by a global pointer, links the new item after the last node, clears its next pointer and returns the head.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6134
name: append_node_to_tail
description: Advances to the last node of a linked list and links the given node after it, clearing the new node's next pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6140
name: link_node_as_next
description: Stores the new node as the next pointer of the given node and clears the new node's next pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6150
name: remove_node_from_list
description: Walks the list from its head until it finds the given node, replaces the link pointing to it with that node's next pointer and calls the release routine for the node.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6186
name: dispatch_list_nodes_by_type
description: Walks the linked list and calls a routine for each node according to its type byte, returning a count of nodes processed; an empty list returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6290
name: process_list_node_record
description: Checks the node's pointers and count, computes its position from a table keyed by its index, walks a null-terminated word list counting its entries and stores that count in the node.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:62B2
name: count_terminated_word_entries
description: Counts the entries of a minus-one terminated word list addressed by the node's table index, stores the count in the node and sets the node's position from the list's first entry.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:62E0
name: count_entries_and_flag_node
description: Counts the entries of a minus-one terminated word list, stores the count in the node, sets the node's active flag and fills in its position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6306
name: set_node_count_eight
description: Sets the node's count to eight and marks it active, then fills its position from the list's first entry and stores the offset values.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6326
name: link_entry_with_table_fields
description: Stores the next list entry, fills the entry's two table-derived fields from its index byte, passes its position to a routine and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:638E
name: emit_entries_until_count
description: While the node's counter is below its limit, calls a routine with the next entry's data and advances the counter, looping until the count is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:63C8
name: emit_entry_pair_sequence
description: Calls routines to emit a pair of table-derived values for each step, advances the node's counter and stores the remaining list pointer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:648E
name: mark_node_done_return_zero
description: Sets the node's done flag to one, stores the remaining list pointer and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6712
name: draw_player_names_panel
description: Draws the player names panel, writing the labels 'Black:' and 'White:' through the text routine inside a fixed box, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6A04
name: build_node_from_table
description: Initialises a node from its table entry when the node is empty, copies two position fields and walks the word list to count its entries, returning whether the entry is valid.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6A34
name: count_list_entries_for_node
description: Walks a minus-one terminated word list for the node, counts its entries, stores half that count in the node and records the node's offset fields.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6A68
name: store_half_count_and_flag
description: Counts the entries of the word list up to its terminator, stores half that count in the node, clears its flag and advances to the next list position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6A82
name: start_node_position_walk
description: Stores the half count, clears the node's flag, sets the list pointer and calls routines that place the node's first position.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6B0A
name: place_node_entries_with_offsets
description: Passes each entry of the node's list to a routine together with its offset and coordinates, advancing the node's counter as it goes.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6BA6
name: store_pointer_return_zero
description: Stores the remaining list pointer into the caller's field and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6BB0
name: reset_node_position_from_table
description: When the node's flag is clear, clears it and positions the node from either its current list entry or the table entry indexed by its byte, then clears its counter.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6BD0
name: position_node_from_table
description: Clears the node's flag, takes the next list entry or the table entry, and passes the node's position to a routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6C30
name: place_next_node_entry
description: Passes the next entry's position to a routine, sets the node's status to one and returns true while more entries remain in the list.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:6C90
name: advance_list_pointer_store
description: Stores the advanced list pointer into the caller's field and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:71CC
name: play_encoded_command_stream
description: Reads an encoded command stream: while each byte has its high bit set it calls a routine with a table entry and an adjusted value, stopping at the minus-one terminator, and records the next byte as the pending value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:71E8
name: read_command_stream_step
description: Reads the next command from the encoded stream and dispatches each high-bit command through a routine until a non-command byte or the terminator is reached.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7246
name: read_next_stream_byte
description: Reads the next byte of the stream into the pending value, clearing the value when the terminator is reached, and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:725A
name: read_stream_byte_unchecked
description: Reads the next stream byte into the pending value without checking for the terminator and returns one.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr unit a - wow][a no cracktro]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr Unit A - WOW][a no cracktro].adf:Battlechess:0:7268
name: clear_pending_stream_value
description: Sets the pending value to zero and returns one.
